summary: The manager is holding the phone when the final returns come in and leaves the call to the candidate.
realLife: In 2004, John Kerry waited until the next morning to concede. After his advisers checked the Ohio returns, he called George W. Bush himself.
inGame: The race-lost scene uses the contest result and the campaign manager.
gates: The final returns show a loss and the call is still outstanding.

turns.what: The manager sets the phone down and looks up the winner's current number.
turns.pulledBy: The number on the campaign sheet goes to an unattended office.
turns.writesBack: The call waits for a verified contact.

turns.what: The phone rings before the candidate has decided whether to dial. It is the other campaign checking how to reach them.
turns.pulledBy: Both headquarters have exchanged numbers and neither candidate has spoken.
turns.writesBack: The manager records a staff call and leaves the candidate’s decision open.
